none: PAS CAM-93F793: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of Valens
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE] ; D/ D N VALEN-[ ]

Copper alloy Nummus of Valens. Mint is uncertain. AD364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALEN-[ ]. Reverse fields and exergue read: -// [ ]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight 1.49g, diameter 14.37mm
